items: 🧪 The project's own tests run six times faster, and new checks keep the docs, the page and the code in step.
🔍 Every change is now also read by two code analysers before it can be released.
⚡ The status appears the moment Discord is reached, not at the next check.
🛡️ An automatic update that is called off meanwhile can no longer end the program.
🧾 Copy diagnostics now also leaves out home folders, file: addresses, computers on your network and the Kodi user name.
🔁 Signing out of Plex at the moment a renewal or server change finishes no longer leaves a sign-in behind.
🪵 A fault in a background task is written to the log instead of closing the program quietly.
🐧 Linux: a broken message on the session bus can no longer keep the program busy for good.
🔒 Built with Go 1.27.3, which stops trusting a set of web certificates its makers found unsafe.
🔑 Plex: your sign-in is only sent to a server once it has shown it is yours (or a friend's, with its own key).
🔄 Updates install themselves when nothing is playing and this window is closed (Windows, Linux).
🔴 The tray icon shows a red dot while an update waits.
⏱️ New versions are looked for every six hours instead of once a day.
🧹 Fixed: a status could stay on Discord after you stopped watching, when Discord answered slowly.
🏁 A video paused at its very end counts as finished: the status goes at once.
📊 The download counter on the project page counts people only, not the project's own checks.
🎁 Specials named in words now also get their name after a year, as in Sample Show (2010) - Special 01.
🏷️ Such a special shows the file's own words (OVA 3, Special 1) instead of Season 0, Episode 3.
🔢 A double episode written S01E05 - S01E06 is shown as S01E05E06.
🔢 More file names are read as episodes: Sample Show [S01E02], S2E5, E05-E06 and Ep. 5.
🎁 Specials named in words (Special 02, OVA 2, SP2) get the show's cover and the special's name.
🧪 The weekly check also tries mpv as its makers release it.
⚡ Kodi and the Linux players read through D-Bus (VLC, Celluloid, ...) show a pause, seek or new file at once.
🎁 Specials (S00E01 and so on) get their episode names without a TMDB key.
🔑 Ready for Plex's newer 7-day sign-in, switched off until Plex requires it (plexJwt in config.json).
🧪 The weekly check also tries VLC and Celluloid as their makers release them.
⚡ mpv and IINA: pausing, seeking or a new file shows on Discord at once instead of within 5 seconds.
🔎 Copy diagnostics explains the current title: what was read from the file name and which catalog matched.
📡 The Privacy tab lists every address the program contacted since it started, how often and when.
🧱 Every release can be rebuilt from its source, byte for byte; it is only published once a second build matches.
📜 New pages: why the program behaves as it does, and how it is made with AI and checked.
🐢 Shows only TVmaze knows get covers and episode names again: the program now waits for its slow search in the background.
🗺️ SECURITY.md lists every address the program connects to, and the Privacy tab links to it.
🔓 The Privacy tab warns that MPC-HC's web interface has no password: web pages you open can reach it while it is on.
🔭 A weekly test against the newest players, servers and cover services, so changes on their side are caught sooner.
⏱️ Stremio: a video keeps showing with Stremio's newer apps, which save your place every 3 minutes instead of 90 seconds.
🧭 MyAnimeList (through Jikan) is no longer asked: its public service closed. AniList and Kitsu still cover anime.
🙏 The Help tab has credits for TMDB and TVmaze, and the welcome card finds Discord's renamed Games & Apps settings.
🍎 macOS 13 or later is needed now (Discord itself needs it), and a server on your home network can be allowed on macOS 15.
🎬 PotPlayer (Windows) and Kodi (any system, also on another device) are supported.
🖼️ Each player shows with its own logo on Discord instead of Media Player Classic's or none.
🙈 Never show these files can hide a whole Plex library, or a folder on your Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server.
🛡️ When Discord runs as administrator, the window says so instead of just waiting for Discord.
🔗 Both text lines on Discord open the title's page, and "Wrong title or cover?" leads to the fix.
🧹 Quitting and updating always clean up after themselves, even while another program is reading the app's files.
🗂️ A tidier window: settings in grouped cards, Updates inside General, and a one-line status card while nothing is shown.
🔢 Click the version number at the top to see the changelog.
🧹 Cleaner code underneath with the same behaviour: sign-ins, player search and cover lookup are simpler to follow.
▶️ A paused player no longer hides another one that is playing.
🎵 Songs played in a video player show as "Listening to" instead of "Watching", and aren't looked up as movies.
🔧 A full round of fixes: safer sign-ins, quicker cover retries, and a tray icon that always shows up.
🔎 The log names the file each title came from, and Copy diagnostics keeps titles and file names, so a wrong match can be traced.
🗂️ Sign-ins have their own Accounts tab; settings are grouped, texts are shorter, and the tray menu shows what the app is doing.
🔧 More reliable: Discord restarts no longer leave a plain status behind, and the settings and cover cache are saved safely.
🎞️ Jellyfin and Emby: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you play on your own server, on any device.
🔗 The second line and the cover on Discord open the title's page (IMDb, AniList, ...), like the button.
🙈 Hide what I'm watching is now one click away in the tray (Windows) and the menu bar (macOS).
🍿 Stremio: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you watch in Stremio, on any device.
💤 While Discord is closed, the app rests: it asks no player and hands its memory back.
🔔 New versions are looked for when the app starts too, and an open window shows one right away.
📰 What's new in an available update is laid out properly on the Updates tab.
📺 Anime episode titles come from MyAnimeList first, which numbers episodes the way your files do.
🎯 Long-running anime no longer show a neighbouring episode's title, or none at all.
🧭 A show that shares its name with a remake or a live-action series gets its own episode list.
🔁 An episode title that did not come is looked up again while the episode plays.
🎬 Plex: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you watch on Plex, on any device.
📝 What's new: this list appears once after each update, and the Changelog button shows it any time.
📊 Your stats on the General tab: videos shown and time watched, kept on this computer only.
💬 Questions such as Quit now appear inside the window instead of a browser box.
💻 Runs on macOS (IINA, mpv, VLC, MPC-QT, in the menu bar) and on Linux (MPRIS players and mpv).
🚀 Start at login works on macOS and Linux too.
📺 Episode titles for anime matched on AniList.
🔎 Films whose file name lost a colon are found again.
🛠️ Update checks keep working past GitHub's hourly limit.
🎬 VLC support, with one-click setup of its web interface.
⚠️ The window says when VLC refuses the password or its port is taken.
🛠️ MPC-HC is no longer mistaken for MPC-QT.
🖼️ The cover now shows in the window's preview.
🔒 A web interface switched on by the setup button only answers this PC.
💤 "Discord on standby" while nothing plays.
🎬 MPC-QT and mpv support, and MPC-BE confirmed working.
🛠️ Quit no longer hangs when Discord stops responding.
⏸️ Your status clears after a 30-minute pause (changeable on the Privacy tab).
📋 Copy diagnostics for bug reports, with titles and paths left out.
🔍 A sharp tray icon on high-DPI screens.
🎬 MPC-BE support through its web interface.
🙈 Hide what I'm watching, and a Never show list for files.
🔔 An update notice next to the tray icon.
👋 A welcome card for new installs.
🔒 Privacy tab with a switch for each online service.
⏸️ Optionally clear your status after a long pause.
👀 A preview of how your status looks on Discord.
✅ Downloads you can verify (checksums and a signed build record).
🛠️ Edge no longer keeps running after the window closes.
🎉 First release: Discord Rich Presence for MPC-HC, with title cleanup and cover art.
